patch_list: Enables the option to show image thumbnails inside archives.
Saves changes to files in local ZIP, 7z, and TAR archives. Requires Android 6.0 or later.
Saves and reuses archive passwords. Requires Android 6.0 or later.
Enables six color themes in settings.
